source_snapshot.procedure: Boot to UEFI Shell, flash BIOS, reboot, then verify version in BIOS setup and OS.
source_snapshot.criteria: The flash completes without errors and the correct version appears in BIOS and OS.
source_snapshot.script: Private check_fw_version_by_ipmitool_raw reference is a post-write readback aid. Thirty minutes attended and thirty machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO because ordinary Linux SSH cannot enter the pre-OS shell; it correctly requires a UEFI boot path, BIOS utility and operator-captured flash log.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with exact vendor UEFI media/path, signed image, utility/command, trained console operator, approval, stable power and recovery.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly identifies the pre-OS boundary and power risk but overstates ordinary SSH inability as non-executability.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly treats the finite operator/vendor inputs as REQUIRES and adds complete target, console and recovery gates.
historical_reviews.history: No exact V003 record exists; V002 is a separate testcase identity.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The UEFI filesystem mapping, utility binary/hash and exact command options must be captured because OS paths and shell mappings are not interchangeable.

original_test_intent: Flash the identified board with an approved BIOS image from its supported pre-OS UEFI Shell path, then prove write completion, reboot recovery and matching BIOS Setup/OS versions.
original_method: Validate board/image/utility/media and UEFI filesystem mapping, preserve baseline, obtain one critical write/reboot approval, have a trained operator run only the documented shell command under stable power with full console capture, then verify boot, BIOS Setup, OS/BMC version and health.
manual_activity: Owner approves exact image/UEFI procedure/recovery; trained operator enters the pre-OS shell, verifies filesystem mapping, runs the one approved command, monitors output and confirms BIOS Setup after reboot.
required_inputs: UEFI Shell media/path and utility binary/hash
Exact documented command/options and filesystem mapping
safety_requirements: Verify image, utility and mapped path before execution
No auto-retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Validate supplied artifacts and shell plan
Collect OS/BMC health and coordinate BIOS Setup evidence
engineer_actions: Verify BIOS Setup and own verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek correctly rejects an ordinary running-OS SSH substitute but gives no executable vendor command. The private version-read script cannot implement or prove the UEFI flash.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain trained-operator execution of the exact vendor UEFI Shell command with validated media/filesystem mapping and full console capture; automate only artifact checks and post-boot evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: UEFI Shell method, reboot, BIOS/OS checks and 30/30-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Hash media, utility and image, record the UEFI mapping and exact command, capture complete terminal status, then correlate post-reboot multi-surface evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds pre-OS path identity, artifact hashes and recoverable approval boundaries.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Proves the intended shell path rather than substituting an OS-level flash or version read.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Pre-OS mistakes or power loss can brick the board and may sever remote access.

project_override_considerations: Project must supply the exact supported UEFI Shell package and command; no OS SSH or generic shell command may be invented, and the version script is post-check only.
expected_evidence: Image/utility/media hashes and UEFI path mapping

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require a UEFI Shell flash; the readback Script is incomplete rather than contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The pre-OS purpose is identifiable; media, utility, command, operator, approval and recovery are finite prerequisites. Ordinary SSH inability does not make the case blocked.

review_improvement: Preserves the required pre-OS method while making filesystem mapping, utility identity, console evidence and recovery auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: The agent cannot reach UEFI through an existing Linux session, but a trained operator can execute a vendor-defined shell path while automation supports verification. That hybrid, package-gated workflow makes REQUIRES more accurate than DeepSeek NO.
